svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Pipe horizontal (obc-horizontal-line, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Automation (P&ID). Box 96x48 px, anchor at (0,24).
